description: This file defines a PHP class 'UpdatePasswordController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the 'Pim' plugin's 'Controller' namespace. The class extends an abstract controller and uses traits to manage user roles. Its primary purpose is to prepare a Vue component with the username property for a password update functionality.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling password update view logic. It prepares and sets a Vue component with the current user's username for rendering the update password interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting the username property. Retrieves the username from the user role manager and attaches it to the component.
